information_notes.raw_text: Information Note on the threat and risk situation in the airspace of the Middle East and Persian Gulf Airspace affected: All altitudes/flight levels in the airspace of: Israel (Tel Aviv FIR – LLLL), Jordan (Amman FIR – OJAC), Oman (Muscat FIR – OOMM) and Saudi Arabia (FIR Jeddah - OEJD). 14/07/2026 31/08/2026 Civil air operators are advised to take potential risk into account in their risk assessment and routing decisions. Note: The recommendations applicable to Jordan contained in this Information Note are superseded by the recommendations set out in the CZIB on the airspace of Jordan issued on 22 July 2026 (ref CZIB-2026-08 ).

Information Note on the threat and risk situation in the airspace of Ethiopia (FIR Addis Ababa - HAAA) Airspace affected: Ethiopia (FIR Addis Ababa - HAAA), in particular northern parts - north of 8.5°N latitude - below FL260. 30/04/2026 31/10/2026 Civil air operators are advised to take potential risk into account in their risk assessment and routing decisions.

Information Note on threat and risk situation in the airspace of Myanmar (FIR Yangon - VYYF) Airspace affected: Airspace above the territory of Myanmar (FIR Yangon – VYYF), below FL 260 30/01/2026 31/07/2026 Civil air operators are advised to take potential risk into account in their risk assessment and routing decisions.
